_note: Pins come from docs/adr/0006-dictionaries.md (downloaded 2026-11-05). The publishers update these files; a checksum mismatch means the file changed and the pin must be refreshed deliberately (and the pack version bumped). A source with a "vendored" path is read from that committed copy instead of the network, because its upstream URL is a rolling "latest" file (MDBG rebuilds CC-CEDICT daily); "url" then records provenance only.
